title: Dhanyawad ke saath stuti gaunga

lines.text: Hai apni daya se tune mujhe...2

chords:
[Chorus]
Dhanyawad ke saath stuti gaunga
Hey Yeshu mere khuda
Upkar tere hai beshumar
Koti koti stuti dhanyawad
..Repeat

[Verse 2]
Yogyata se badh ke diya
Hai apni daya se tune mujhe...2
Mangne se jyada mila mujhe
Aabhari hoon prabhu main...2

[Verse 3]
Tu hai saccha zinda khuda
Tujh par hi bharosa mera...2
Sewa poori karke paaon inaam
Prabhu aisa do vardan...2
